name: Build Android APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend

    steps:
      # ── Checkout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # ── Toolchain ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Set up Node.js 18
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          # cache disabled: repo has no package-lock.json (npm install creates it)

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      # ── Android SDK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Accept Android SDK licenses
        run: yes | $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses || true

      - name: Install required Android SDK components
        run: |
          $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager \
            "platform-tools" \
            "platforms;android-34" \
            "build-tools;34.0.0" || true

      # ── Gradle cache ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: gradle-${{ hashFiles('frontend/android/**/*.gradle*', 'frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
          restore-keys: gradle-

      # ── Node dependencies ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm install --legacy-peer-deps

      # ── Android project config ──────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Set up local.properties
        run: echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" > android/local.properties

      - name: Write root build.gradle
        run: |
          cat > android/build.gradle << 'EOF'
          buildscript {
              ext {
                  buildToolsVersion = "34.0.0"
                  minSdkVersion     = 24
                  compileSdkVersion = 34
                  targetSdkVersion  = 34
              }
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
              }
              dependencies {
                  classpath("com.android.tools.build:gradle:8.3.2")
              }
          }

          allprojects {
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
                  maven { url "$rootDir/../node_modules/react-native/android" }
                  maven { url "$rootDir/../node_modules/jsc-android/dist" }
              }
          }

          task clean(type: Delete) {
              delete rootProject.buildDir
          }
          EOF

      - name: Write app/build.gradle
        run: |
          cat > android/app/build.gradle << 'EOF'
          apply plugin: 'com.android.application'

          android {
              compileSdk 34
              namespace "com.netshare"

              defaultConfig {
                  applicationId "com.netshare"
                  minSdk        24
                  targetSdk     34
                  versionCode   1
                  versionName   "1.0"
              }

              buildTypes {
                  debug   { debuggable true }
                  release {
                      minifyEnabled false
                      proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android-optimize.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro'
                  }
              }

              compileOptions {
                  sourceCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_17
                  targetCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_17
              }
          }

          dependencies {
              implementation "com.facebook.react:react-android:0.74.2"
              implementation "com.facebook.react:hermes-android:0.74.2"
              implementation 'androidx.appcompat:appcompat:1.6.1'
              implementation 'androidx.core:core-ktx:1.12.0'
              implementation 'org.java-websocket:Java-WebSocket:1.5.4'
              implementation 'com.google.code.gson:gson:2.10.1'
              implementation 'org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk15on:1.70'
          }
          EOF

      - name: Write gradle.properties
        run: |
          cat > android/gradle.properties << 'EOF'
          org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m
          android.useAndroidX=true
          android.enableJetifier=true
          EOF

      - name: Write settings.gradle
        run: |
          cat > android/settings.gradle << 'EOF'
          rootProject.name = 'NshareApp'
          include ':app'
          EOF

      # ── Gradle wrapper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Write gradle-wrapper.properties
        run: |
          mkdir -p android/gradle/wrapper
          cat > android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties << 'EOF'
          distributionBase=GRADLE_USER_HOME
          distributionPath=wrapper/dists
          distributionUrl=https\://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.6-bin.zip
          zipStoreBase=GRADLE_USER_HOME
          zipStorePath=wrapper/dists
          EOF

      - name: Generate gradlew (if missing)
        run: |
          if [ ! -f android/gradlew ]; then
            gradle wrapper --gradle-version=8.6 --project-dir=android
          fi
          chmod +x android/gradlew

      # ── Java source scaffold ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Create Java source directories
        run: |
          mkdir -p android/app/src/main/java/com/netshare
          mkdir -p android/app/src/main/java/netshare
          mkdir -p android/app/src/main/res/values
          mkdir -p android/app/src/main/assets

      - name: Write MainApplication.java
        run: |
          cat > android/app/src/main/java/com/netshare/MainApplication.java << 'EOF'
          package com.netshare;

          import android.app.Application;
          import com.facebook.react.ReactApplication;
          import com.facebook.react.ReactNativeHost;
          import com.facebook.react.ReactPackage;
          import com.facebook.react.defaults.DefaultReactNativeHost;
          import java.util.Arrays;
          import java.util.List;

          // NOTE: PackageList is auto-generated by RN autolinking at build time.
          // We do NOT import it here — instead we register VpnPackage directly
          // in getPackages() to avoid "cannot find symbol: PackageList" errors
          // when the workflow writes this file before autolinking has run.

          public class MainApplication extends Application implements ReactApplication {

              private final ReactNativeHost mReactNativeHost =
                  new DefaultReactNativeHost(this) {
                      @Override public boolean getUseDeveloperSupport() { return false; }

                      @Override
                      protected List<ReactPackage> getPackages() {
                          // Register only our VpnPackage — no autolinking needed
                          // since this project has no other native modules.
                          return Arrays.<ReactPackage>asList(new VpnPackage());
                      }

                      @Override protected String  getJSMainModuleName() { return "index"; }
                      @Override protected boolean isNewArchEnabled()     { return false; }
                      @Override protected Boolean isHermesEnabled()      { return true; }
                  };

              @Override public ReactNativeHost getReactNativeHost() { return mReactNativeHost; }
              @Override public void onCreate() { super.onCreate(); }
          }
          EOF

      - name: Write MainActivity.java
        run: |
          cat > android/app/src/main/java/com/netshare/MainActivity.java << 'EOF'
          package com.netshare;

          import android.content.Intent;
          import com.facebook.react.ReactActivity;
          import com.facebook.react.ReactActivityDelegate;
          import com.facebook.react.bridge.ReactContext;
          import com.facebook.react.defaults.DefaultReactActivityDelegate;
          import netshare.VpnModule;

          public class MainActivity extends ReactActivity {

              @Override protected String getMainComponentName() { return "Nshare"; }

              @Override
              protected ReactActivityDelegate createReactActivityDelegate() {
                  return new DefaultReactActivityDelegate(this, getMainComponentName(), false);
              }

              @Override
              public void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data) {
                  super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
                  if (getReactInstanceManager() == null) return;
                  ReactContext ctx = getReactInstanceManager().getCurrentReactContext();
                  if (ctx == null) return;
                  VpnModule module = ctx.getNativeModule(VpnModule.class);
                  if (module != null) module.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
              }
          }
          EOF

      - name: Write VpnPackage.java
        run: |
          cat > android/app/src/main/java/com/netshare/VpnPackage.java << 'EOF'
          package com.netshare;

          import com.facebook.react.ReactPackage;
          import com.facebook.react.bridge.NativeModule;
          import com.facebook.react.bridge.ReactApplicationContext;
          import com.facebook.react.uimanager.ViewManager;
          import java.util.Arrays;
          import java.util.Collections;
          import java.util.List;
          import netshare.VpnModule;

          public class VpnPackage implements ReactPackage {
              @Override
              public List<NativeModule> createNativeModules(ReactApplicationContext ctx) {
                  return Arrays.<NativeModule>asList(new VpnModule(ctx));
              }
              @Override
              public List<ViewManager> createViewManagers(ReactApplicationContext ctx) {
                  return Collections.emptyList();
              }
          }
          EOF

      # ── No patching needed — files committed directly to repo ──────────────────
      - name: Verify Java source files exist
        run: |
          ls android/app/src/main/java/netshare/NetShareVpnService.java
          ls android/app/src/main/java/netshare/VpnModule.java
          echo "Java source files OK"

            # ── AndroidManifest ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Write AndroidManifest.xml
        run: |
          cat > android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml << 'EOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">

              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE" />
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED" />
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE" />
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE" />
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE" />
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE" />

              <application
                  android:name=".MainApplication"
                  android:label="NShare"
                  android:theme="@style/AppTheme">

                  <activity
                      android:name=".MainActivity"
                      android:exported="true"
                      android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize">
                      <intent-filter>
                          <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                          <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
                      </intent-filter>
                  </activity>

                  <service
                      android:name="netshare.NetShareVpnService"
                      android:exported="false"
                      android:foregroundServiceType="specialUse"
                      android:permission="android.permission.BIND_VPN_SERVICE">
                      <intent-filter>
                          <action android:name="android.net.VpnService" />
                      </intent-filter>
                      <property
                          android:name="android.app.PROPERTY_SPECIAL_USE_FGS_SUBTYPE"
                          android:value="VPN tunneling for internet sharing" />
                  </service>

              </application>
          </manifest>
          EOF

      # ── Resources ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Write strings.xml
        run: |
          cat > android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml << 'EOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <resources>
              <string name="app_name">NShare</string>
          </resources>
          EOF

      - name: Write styles.xml
        run: |
          cat > android/app/src/main/res/values/styles.xml << 'EOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <resources>
              <style name="AppTheme" parent="Theme.AppCompat.Light.NoActionBar" />
          </resources>
          EOF

      - name: Write proguard-rules.pro
        run: |
          cat > android/app/proguard-rules.pro << 'EOF'
          -keep class com.facebook.react.** { *; }
          -keep class org.java_websocket.**  { *; }
          -keep class com.google.gson.**     { *; }
          -keep class com.netshare.**        { *; }
          -keep class netshare.**            { *; }
          # Bouncy Castle (needed for X25519 on Android < 13)
          -keep class org.bouncycastle.**    { *; }
          EOF

      # ── JS config files ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Write app.json
        run: |
          cat > app.json << 'EOF'
          { "name": "Nshare", "displayName": "NShare" }
          EOF

      - name: Write metro.config.js
        run: |
          cat > metro.config.js << 'EOF'
          const {getDefaultConfig, mergeConfig} = require('@react-native/metro-config');
          module.exports = mergeConfig(getDefaultConfig(__dirname), {});
          EOF

      - name: Write babel.config.js
        run: |
          cat > babel.config.js << 'EOF'
          module.exports = { presets: ['module:@react-native/babel-preset'] };
          EOF

      # ── Bundle JS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Bundle React Native JS
        run: |
          npx react-native bundle \
            --platform android \
            --dev false \
            --entry-file index.js \
            --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle \
            --assets-dest android/app/src/main/res

      # ── Build APK ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Build Debug APK
        run: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
        env:
          GRADLE_OPTS: '-Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=512m'
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}

      # ── Upload ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: nshare-debug-apk
          path: frontend/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 30
